profile: first order taylor series approximation: a line or hyperplane tangent to a function at its minimum point, also known as a first order Taylor approximation. A hyperplane in general is defined by w0 + x1w1 + x2w2 + ... + xNwN = y. As a hyperplane itself, this approximation conveniently provides a descent direction during gradient descent.
